    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">LLVM/Clang LibTooling Out-of-Tree开发</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div data-page-id="HFt0d0VKfoCSuCx0MCTcrcLbnCh" data-lark-html-role="root" data-docx-has-block-data="true">
<blockquote class=" old-record-id-Ey5JdWhIzoDWSaxoYxHcIqQFnMc" data-type="quote_container">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-BehgdsMsFogqzHx7JT2cMSeOnEd">Clang LibTooling官方给出的教程中给出了直接在LLVM/Clang代码目录下进行工具开发的示例，但这样对于代码管理不甚方便，为此，尝试独立于LLVM代码树开发（即Out-of-Tree）</div>
</blockquote>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-JMa0drBOhonMf7x2PJGcuJuInZf">省流：在编译Clang时，添加CMake选项：-DLLVM_ENABLE_RTTI=ON</div>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-REXHdY6M6onG2xxPV3TcFVqhnwh">官方Tutorial分析</h2>
<blockquote class=" old-record-id-XwFsd97yjoQUzjxkWOqc1Xfpnef" data-type="quote_container">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-DzrudwsesogSwfxYaKQcRH1onab">官方给出的LibTooling Tutorial大体上已经满足了开发环境的配置</div>
</blockquote>
<div class="j-block-container old-record-id-BuLHddljVooaQJxr6EwcM0hmnDe" data-meta-block-props="{&quot;blockType&quot;:&quot;LINK_BLOCK&quot;,&quot;props&quot;:{&quot;data&quot;:{&quot;cover_height&quot;:0,&quot;cover_url&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;cover_width&quot;:0,&quot;summary&quot;:&quot;Step 0: Obtaining Clang ¶ As Clang is part of the LLVM project, you’ll need to download LLVM’s source code first. Both Clang and LLVM are in the same git repository, under different directories. For f&quot;,&quot;title&quot;:&quot;Tutorial for building tools using LibTooling and LibASTMatchers ¶&quot;,&quot;url&quot;:&quot;https://clang.llvm.org/docs/LibASTMatchersTutorial.html&quot;,&quot;icon&quot;:&quot;https://s3-imfile.feishucdn.com/static-resource/v1/v3_00pn_04f9d149-d1e7-4ac8-bd38-746caf6c45dg~?image_size=noop&amp;cut_type=&amp;quality=&amp;format=image&amp;sticker_format=.webp&quot;,&quot;linkProvider&quot;:&quot;smartLink&quot;,&quot;linkType&quot;:&quot;bookmark&quot;,&quot;entityId&quot;:&quot;&quot;},&quot;displayMode&quot;:&quot;block&quot;,&quot;viewType&quot;:&quot;card&quot;},&quot;blockId&quot;:&quot;6def32f5-dcb7-43fa-b4a8-be7736216c37&quot;}">官方Tutorial：<a href="https://clang.llvm.org/docs/LibASTMatchersTutorial.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="block-paste-placeholder">https://clang.llvm.org/docs/LibASTMatchersTutorial.html</span></a></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-TOGjdfJhuoxGpYxO2WHcLyeonDe">如果使用官方的配置方法，尝试<strong>在其他路径</strong>下撰写项目，仅在编译时再链接LLVM/Clang库则会出现如下报错：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Uq3ydoWELoBZedxqTS5c0l86ngg"><code class="language-TypeScript" data-lark-language="TypeScript" data-wrap="false">user@debian:~/my-tool/build$ make 
 [ 50%] Linking CXX executable my_tool 
 /usr/bin/ld: CMakeFiles/my_tool.dir/src/MyTool.cpp.o:(.data.rel.ro._ZTIZN5clang7tooling24newFrontendActionFactoryINS_12ast_matchers11MatchFinderEEESt10unique_ptrINS0_21FrontendActionFactoryESt14default_deleteIS5_EEPT_PNS0_19SourceFileCallbacksEEN28FrontendActionFactoryAdapter22ConsumerFactoryAdaptorE[_ZTIZN5clang7tooling24newFrontendActionFactoryINS_12ast_matchers11MatchFinderEEESt10unique_ptrINS0_21FrontendActionFactoryESt14default_deleteIS5_EEPT_PNS0_19SourceFileCallbacksEEN28FrontendActionFactoryAdapter22ConsumerFactoryAdaptorE]+0x10): undefined reference to `typeinfo for clang::ASTFrontendAction' 
 /usr/bin/ld: CMakeFiles/my_tool.dir/src/MyTool.cpp.o:(.data.rel.ro._ZTIZN5clang7tooling24newFrontendActionFactoryINS_12ast_matchers11MatchFinderEEESt10unique_ptrINS0_21FrontendActionFactoryESt14default_deleteIS5_EEPT_PNS0_19SourceFileCallbacksEE28FrontendActionFactoryAdapter[_ZTIZN5clang7tooling24newFrontendActionFactoryINS_12ast_matchers11MatchFinderEEESt10unique_ptrINS0_21FrontendActionFactoryESt14default_deleteIS5_EEPT_PNS0_19SourceFileCallbacksEE28FrontendActionFactoryAdapter]+0x10): undefined reference to `typeinfo for clang::tooling::FrontendActionFactory' 
 /usr/bin/ld: CMakeFiles/my_tool.dir/src/MyTool.cpp.o:(.data.rel.ro._ZTI15FunctionPrinter[_ZTI15FunctionPrinter]+0x10): undefined reference to `typeinfo for clang::ast_matchers::MatchFinder::MatchCallback' 
 collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status 
 make[2]: *** [CMakeFiles/my_tool.dir/build.make:156: my_tool] Error 1 
 make[1]: *** [CMakeFiles/Makefile2:351: CMakeFiles/my_tool.dir/all] Error 2 
 make: *** [Makefile:91: all] Error 2</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-NqAUdbFAboRgjtxcz3pcE3SBnaf"><strong>报错分析：</strong></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-QBmEdn8r9oJONixDcM9cH2ejnOh">这是一个非常典型的C++编译选项不匹配导致的链接错误： <code>undefined reference to 'typeinfo for ...'</code> 意味着代码和链接的库之间 <strong>RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) 设置不一致</strong>（from Gemini2.5 pro)</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XWL3dY7CHoKW9GxUBiYccx5An0b">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-XBTzdINYhof1pyxo5L2cF1s3nJh">Out-of-Tree开发环境配置</h2>
<blockquote class=" old-record-id-PufGd5wzAo4drOxy4Eicq71envf" data-type="quote_container">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-FUgGduUYAo8ydrxNbypcsJ4fnGh">下面我们梳理Out-of-Tree开发环境配置</div>
</blockquote>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-J3NDdRE0ioGlvoxC60CcRlZHnlt">Step 0: Obtaining Clang</h3>
<blockquote class=" old-record-id-Reo1dx8EUoxRySxh7BWcnZ04nSc" data-type="quote_container">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-MQWidPE3oolZwNxYdwactw8UnWc"><strong>(与官方</strong><strong><a href="https://clang.llvm.org/docs/LibASTMatchersTutorial.html" data-lark-is-custom="true" rel="noopener nofollow">Tutorial</a></strong><strong>相同）</strong></div>
</blockquote>
<div class="ace-line text-indent ace-line old-record-id-H6qYd85GToS6ISxpdcjcosVTnZc">As Clang is part of the LLVM project, you’ll need to download LLVM’s source code first. Both Clang and LLVM are in the same git repository, under different directories. For further information, see the <strong><a href="https://llvm.org/docs/GettingStarted.html" data-lark-is-custom="true" rel="noopener nofollow">getting started guide</a></strong>.</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-BuBVdIWI2oaegNx63RjcSFYdnnc"><code class="language-Bash" data-lark-language="Bash" data-wrap="false">mkdir ~/clang-llvm &amp;&amp; cd ~/clang-llvmgit clone https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project.git</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-FKEhdYrz1o8TiSxPHy9civcinke">Next, you need to obtain the CMake build system and Ninja build tool.</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LCFGdMd7Hob7rFxBqEKc5RWnnWf"><code class="language-Bash" data-lark-language="Bash" data-wrap="false">cd ~/clang-llvm
git clone https://github.com/martine/ninja.git
cd ninja
git checkout release
./configure.py --bootstrap
sudo cp ninja /usr/bin/
cd ~/clang-llvm
git clone https://gitlab.kitware.com/cmake/cmake.git
cd cmake
./bootstrap
make
sudo make install</code></pre>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-GSZGdU971o7citx7fMWcvKuonGV">Step 1: 编译构建Clang</h3>
<blockquote class=" old-record-id-GpAmdEwPxomIUvxeEQuck37Qn6g" data-type="quote_container">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-AxNLd5l5JoCGerxmYXyceOFnnAg"><strong>（与官方不同，out-of-tree环境）</strong></div>
</blockquote>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ILXGdfgVqoUdMex3N7ccN9xLnem"><code class="language-Bash" data-lark-language="Bash" data-wrap="false">cd ~/clang-llvm
mkdir build &amp;&amp; cd build
cmake -G Ninja ../llvm-project/llvm \
    -DLLVM_ENABLE_PROJECTS="clang;clang-tools-extra" \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
    -DLLVM_BUILD_TESTS=ON    \
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local \ #安装及库文件路径
    -DLLVM_ENABLE_RTTI=ON   # out-of-tree关键选项
ninja
ninja check       # Test LLVM only.
ninja clang-test  # Test Clang only.</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-VEW8dDFRUoD6eLxwxnScG2xvnEe">最后将编译好的clang及其库文件<strong>安装</strong>至系统</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RjtCduZSpo8HiixFDMycwihhnig"><code class="language-Bash" data-lark-language="Bash" data-wrap="false">sudo ninja install</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-MQDHdFtajoApmzxmcsFcdi1fnOf">简单验证：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-VqCNd6WOGodqvnx2m7ScrNGjnIf"><code class="language-Bash" data-lark-language="Bash" data-wrap="false"># 确认 libclangTooling.a 已被安装到指定位置
ls /usr/local/lib/libclangTooling.a
# 输出：/usr/local/lib/libclangTooling.a</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RFUDdGfw7ot5frxdYzNcZfuPnKW">至此，基础out-of-tree环境基础完成</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KRJidhrqyoCPX9xQrescAnB5njb">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-Cw2zdkjZfo4b8uxbx7Uc3aTTnzg"><strong>创建独立的 Out-of-Tree LibTooling 项目 </strong></h2>
<ol class="list-number1" start="1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RdOEdcz8ToczWBxWiFGcgOJqn7c" data-list="number"><strong>项目结构</strong></li>
</ol>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-JkD7dxlvooxfCuxlEzScNHronAh"><code class="language-Plain Text" data-lark-language="Plain Text" data-wrap="false">my-tool/
├── build         
├── CMakeLists.txt  #项目CMakeLists
├── src
│   └── MyTool.cpp  #项目源代码
└── test_samples    #测试用例目录
    └── test_function_name.c</code></pre>
<ol class="list-number1" start="2">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-PlxkdJa1MoGVDrx2OZicDznInhg" data-list="number"><strong>CMakeLists.txt</strong></li>
</ol>
<blockquote class=" old-record-id-PmKIdy83lo4cm0xQYLIcZnwrn0T" data-type="quote_container">
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-WU19dJql1opQUpxeteqcA77RnQb">可直接复制使用，注意修改地方已经标明</div>
</blockquote>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-EK5EdupUdot5T3x3qxncedGlnPg"><code class="language-Plain Text" data-lark-language="Plain Text" data-wrap="false">cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(MyTool)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
find_package(LLVM REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(Clang REQUIRED CONFIG)

# 添加头文件路径
include_directories(${LLVM_INCLUDE_DIRS})
include_directories(${CLANG_INCLUDE_DIRS})
link_directories(${LLVM_LIBRARY_DIRS})

# 定义可执行文件
# ==========注意修改此处1==========
add_executable(my_tool 
  src/MyTool.cpp
)
# ==========注意修改此处2==========
# 链接 Clang 库
target_link_libraries(my_tool
  PRIVATE
  clangTooling
  clangAST
  clangASTMatchers
  clangBasic
  clangFrontend
  clangSerialization
  clangDriver
  LLVMSupport
)</code></pre>
<ol class="list-number1" start="3">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Fentd1hIFo25Hsx8QEhcxYfOnEg" data-list="number"><strong> 撰写最小化的工具代码 (MyTool.cpp)</strong></li>
</ol>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-H8zVd6o8ioyZqgxgUFfcFwFhnje"><code class="language-C++" data-lark-language="C++" data-wrap="false">#include "clang/ASTMatchers/ASTMatchers.h"
#include "clang/ASTMatchers/ASTMatchFinder.h"
#include "clang/Tooling/CommonOptionsParser.h"
#include "clang/Tooling/Tooling.h"
#include "llvm/Support/CommandLine.h"

// 使用 namespaces 简化代码
using namespace clang;
using namespace clang::ast_matchers;
using namespace clang::tooling;
using namespace llvm;

// 定义一个 Matcher 来查找所有函数定义（不仅仅是声明）
// .bind("func") 将匹配到的节点绑定到名字 "func" 上，方便后续在回调中获取
DeclarationMatcher FunctionMatcher = functionDecl(isDefinition()).bind("func");

// 定义一个回调类，当 Matcher 找到匹配项时，它的 run 方法会被调用
class FunctionPrinter : public MatchFinder::MatchCallback {
public:
  // 重写 run 方法
  virtual void run(const MatchFinder::MatchResult &amp;Result) {
    // 从匹配结果中获取绑定的 "func" 节点
    // 并将其转换为 FunctionDecl (函数声明) 类型
    if (const FunctionDecl *FD = Result.Nodes.getNodeAs&lt;FunctionDecl&gt;("func")) {
      // 获取函数名
      StringRef FuncName = FD-&gt;getName();
      // 获取源码位置信息
      SourceManager &amp;SM = *Result.SourceManager;
      SourceLocation FuncLocation = FD-&gt;getLocation();

      // 使用 llvm::outs()（一个线程安全的cout）打印结果
      outs() &lt;&lt; "Found function: " &lt;&lt; FuncName &lt;&lt; " at "
             &lt;&lt; FuncLocation.printToString(SM) &lt;&lt; "\n";
    }
  }
};

// 为我们的工具设置命令行选项分类
static cl::OptionCategory MyToolCategory("find-functions options");

int main(int argc, const char **argv) {
  // 使用 CommonOptionsParser 解析命令行参数，它会自动处理 -- 和 compile_commands.json
  auto ExpectedParser = CommonOptionsParser::create(argc, argv, MyToolCategory);
  if (!ExpectedParser) {
    errs() &lt;&lt; ExpectedParser.takeError();
    return 1;
  }
  CommonOptionsParser &amp;OptionsParser = ExpectedParser.get();
  ClangTool Tool(OptionsParser.getCompilations(), OptionsParser.getSourcePathList());

  // 创建我们的回调实例
  FunctionPrinter Printer;
  MatchFinder Finder;
  // 将 Matcher 和回调实例注册到 MatchFinder 中
  Finder.addMatcher(FunctionMatcher, &amp;Printer);

  // 运行 ClangTool，它会解析AST并触发我们的回调
  return Tool.run(newFrontendActionFactory(&amp;Finder).get());
}</code></pre>
<ol class="list-number1" start="4">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-D0BudBuhJo2HRmxip1IcZjhAnQk" data-list="number"><strong>测试用例</strong><strong>（test_function_name.c）</strong></li>
</ol>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-WhWCdbkenoAN8MxmbigcyJJ7ngb"><code class="language-C" data-lark-language="C" data-wrap="false">void helper_function() {
    // 函数体为空，无任何外部调用
}

int add(int a, int b) {
    return a + b;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    // 声明一个变量并调用内部函数
    int result = add(5, 3);
    helper_function();
    
    // (void)result; 
    
    return 0;
}

// 一个只有声明没有定义的函数 
void forward_declared_function();</code></pre>
<ol class="list-number1" start="5">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ICTjdY3Iroc1dSxNrBhcVofQnve" data-list="number"><strong>编译与运行</strong></li>
</ol>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-BGRvdcvT9oCgk8x40MJce5ZUnde">编译：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-CQ9MdoPV4ou9RaxHfQ7cHP1mnFc"><code class="language-Plain Text" data-lark-language="Plain Text" data-wrap="false">cd my-tool/build
cmake ..
make</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-DgYnd7dn8o84ZjxuUmGc46m8n0g">运行工具：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-CK2sdpFVfolGSlx8opRcBHQUnCh"><code class="language-Plain Text" data-lark-language="Plain Text" data-wrap="false"> ./my_tool ../test_samples/test_function_name.c  --</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XysxdDhNvoaw12xWRE6cwczqnGh">应当出现如下结果：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-L79DdsEa6oibPcxmTinc7dZdned"><code class="language-Bash" data-lark-language="Bash" data-wrap="false">liu@debian:~/code/my-tool/build$ ./my_tool ../test_samples/test_function_name.c  --
Found function: helper_function at /home/liu/code/my-tool/build/../test_samples/test_function_name.c:3:6
Found function: add at /home/liu/code/my-tool/build/../test_samples/test_function_name.c:7:5
Found function: main at /home/liu/code/my-tool/build/../test_samples/test_function_name.c:11:5</code></pre>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-RIcHdPxCVoIRGTxZZygcAdBenHV"><strong>附录：</strong></h2>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-Y3IjdYVV0o8CZCxCO3qc3HYCnDh"><strong>debug方法</strong></h4>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-CRCYd5eHwoQQQtx1kLxcSDzxnhm" data-list="bullet"><code>make VERBOSE=1</code>: 查看CMake执行的完整、真实的编译和链接命令，检查是否有多余的编译标志（如<code>-fno-rtti</code>）。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SCNGdazQMoVIsmxlrXmcN3JTnyc" data-list="bullet"><code>llvm-config --cxxflags --libs</code>: 查看已安装的LLVM环境推荐外部应用使用的编译和链接参数。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-WBVxdLR7pojgWKxJ2owcK3den2g" data-list="bullet"><code>find / -name "libclangTooling.a"</code>: 在整个系统中查找文件，确认其真实位置和名称。</li>
</ul>
</div>
